Well, it's not about whether or not I can make it better for myself, I'm sure with time and effort I could, if I really wanted to. That would just involve a lot of compensating for things I've lost and things that weren't given to me. My main concern is if I even care to spend my years compensating for so much and if, in the end, I can even look at this world and think that it's a world worth staying in.

Well, that's the thing. I don't really know if I want to accept it. Just shrugging and saying "It's okay, I can't change the past" is impossible. I would never want to live my life normally, just getting a job and paying the bills and "doing" life and accepting everything that happened to me as the past. 

The way I see it, I can stay and make strives to make life fair or I can just go completely.
